coordinateFrame: ENU metres; up is relative to N2000 7.5m. UV v is PNG-down, already flipped from city JSON.
productionPixelPolicy: Licensed City of Helsinki same-building raw PNG donors plus original procedural stone, frames and glass. Reference photos/drawings are visual evidence only.

north-end.reference: NRT 2020 west elevation northern end; stair at chart left retained. Approximate opening widths read from the drawing; not a survey.

north-return.reference: NRT 2020 north elevation lower plinth and narrow service entrance beside the stair. Existing unobscured window bank retained.

congress-end.reference: NRT 2020 floor plan PDF p59 resolves one central opening group on an otherwise solid south end wall. The exact original central bank is retained. P58 locates two lower first-floor entrances; expanded columns around those positions stay protected below runtime Y 1.7. The exposed Y 1.7..2.2 band uses the same licensed granite material as its adjacent solid plinth; final ground minima 1.80011 and 2.09368 bury that band's bottom by at least 0.10 m. P55/P63 identify the separate foreground elliptical ventilation tower. Along positions are approximate registration of the plan endpoints to the exact wall endpoints.
congress-end.unresolved: Two hidden lower first-floor entrance columns remain original source pixels: alongS[1017,1019.6] and [1024.3,1027.1], H[-5.8,1.7]. Their lower architecture is not invented. Original photographed foliage in the exposed H[1.7,2.2] band is reconstructed with the existing same-building granite donor. The central second-floor opening bank at H[2.2,4.95] remains source pixels.

congress-curves.reference: NRT 2020 west elevation curved congress wing; geometry supplies the original curve divisions. Glazing, white spandrels, lower strip and individual plinth entrances authored from elevation. Frame widths and glass interiors are approximate.
